DIAGNOSIS READY: Myasthenia Gravis

The mention of diplopia (double vision) alongside progressive weakness and fatigue is highly specific for Myasthenia Gravis. While I have requested initial labs to rule out metabolic or infectious causes, the clinical picture strongly points toward an autoimmune neuromuscular junction disorder. A definitive diagnosis would typically involve checking for anti-acetylcholine receptor antibodies.
